title: Saving the mapping posts a held move on its own
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure AccountingHub is enabled for the organization and the test location has no QuickBooks Online connection.
  • Have a new No Charge category for this test, category A, whose Account Mappings row is empty.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category category A, in status Approved, whose vendor bill line move of $125.00 is Held for the empty row.
custom_steps:
1. Open Accounting > Account Mappings.
  2. Pick an expense account in category A's row.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Open Accounting > Accounting Events.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The rows show.

Step 2:

  • The account shows.

Step 3:

  • The mapping is saved.

Step 4:

  • The held move is now posted: it is retried automatically when the mapping is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11763 (Story 6, AccountingHub account mapping), story SV-11765 (Story 8, AccountingHub, the closed work order and its parts cost)

  • S8-R3: “Vendor bill lines, reclass entries and the shop supplies entry follow Story 7, S7-R3, S7-R3a, S7-R4 and S7-R4a, with the hub's accounts (the credit goes to the Shop supplies expense row, seeded 5100 Shop Supplies COGS: in the hub the amount lowers cost, where in QuickBooks it raises shop supplies income; gross and net profit come out the same in both, and the accountant can remap the row). A vendor bill or vendor credit line on internal or no-charge work posts to the category's expense account (Key Decision); when that category row is empty, the bill or credit posts as today, so the vendor can be paid, and only that line's move to the category account is Held with the reason "No Charge: [Category] row not mapped" (or "Internal: [Category] row not mapped") until the row is mapped. This is the one entry the hub raises itself instead of receiving it from core (confirmed by the hub owner on 2026-11-09), with this lifecycle: when the mapping is saved, the Held move is retried automatically, subject to the other posting checks, an open accounting period included; a bill or credit amended while the move is Held turns it Dismissed and the updated document is evaluated again, with a replacement move only when one is still needed; a bill or credit voided while Held turns it Dismissed with no replacement; a bill or credit amended or voided after the move posted reverses the original move and posts an updated one when needed, coordinated with the bill or credit correction so the same amount is never reversed twice; Held moves can be retried, Dismissed ones are never replayed (S4-R3); the move shows in reconciliation and on the Accounting Events page with its status and a link to the source bill or credit and its line. Invoices, vendor bills, credits and payments keep today's statuses.”
  • S6-R4: “Saving a mapping retries any events held for a missing account (Story 8).”
  • S8-N2: “If a mapped account on either side of the entry is missing or inactive, or the posting date falls in a closed fiscal period or in none, the event gets a status Held (new in the hub) on the Accounting Events page with the reason ("No Charge: [Category] row not mapped" or "Internal: [Category] row not mapped", the list name telling the two apart (S8-R7), "Shop supplies expense is not mapped", "Inventory asset is not mapped", "Parts cost of goods sold is not mapped", "Period [name] is closed", or the hub's existing "No open fiscal period covers [date]."), the existing Retry action, and automatic retry when the mapping is saved or the period opened. Other events for the organization keep flowing. A held Close withdrawn by Reopen becomes Dismissed (S4-E1). Held exists for these work-order entries only (Close, reversal, no-charge line, and the move of a vendor bill or credit line to its category account, S8-R3); invoices, vendor bills, credits and payments keep today's statuses.”
